where: Section 3 (paragraph on prime order, and the paragraph on element order) and Quiz Q6
problem: The notation for the cyclic subgroup generated by g has been swallowed by the HTML filter. The text reads 'the subgroup  generated by g', 'The only possibility is p, so  = G and G is cyclic', and in Q6 '|| divides 13. ... Thus =G.' A student sees broken sentences such as 'so = G', which is not a valid statement.
fix: Use Unicode angle brackets: 'the subgroup ⟨g⟩ generated by g', 'so ⟨g⟩ = G and G is cyclic', and in Q6 '|⟨g⟩| divides 13 ... Thus ⟨g⟩ = G.'

problem: 'ord(g)' is used without being defined; a reader meeting the symbol for the first time has to guess it is the order of the element.
fix: Add one line: 'ord(g), the order of g, is the smallest positive integer n with gⁿ = e (written n·g = 0 in additive notation).'
